title: MGHomes
description: MGHomes summary: "MGHomes Premium – The ultimate homes plugin with GUI, economy, MySQL, and advanced features for SMP, Survival, Hardcore, and Lifesteal servers."
body:
**🌟 MGHomes Premium 🌟**

  Welcome to **MGHomes Premium** – the ultimate homes plugin for **Survival**, **Lifesteal**, **Hardcore**, and **SMP** servers!  
  Designed for performance, flexibility, and premium-quality features, MGHomes is built for both small and large servers.

  **🔹 Why Choose MGHomes Premium?**
  - Fully customizable **configuration** and **messages**
  - Optimized for performance on small & large servers
  - Supports **YAML & MySQL** storage
  - **PlaceholderAPI** ready
  - Economy integration via **Vault**
  - Modern GUI system *(coming soon 🚀)*
  - Multi-world support
  - Cooldowns, safe teleport, **invite & public homes**
  - Admin tools for managing other players’ homes
  - Perfect for premium server setups

  **✨ Core Features**
  - Set, teleport, and delete homes with **permission control**
  - Configurable home limits per **rank** (Default: 2, VIP: 5, Premium: 10, Staff: 25, Admin: Unlimited)
  - Teleport delays with **cooldowns**
  - Cancel teleport if player **moves** or takes **damage**
  - Safe teleport checks for lava, void, or unsafe spots
  - Invite system for **sharing homes**
  - Public homes for community engagement
  - GUI system *(coming soon)* with navigation items
  - Economy costs configurable per action
  - Messages fully configurable in `messages.yml`
  - Admin commands: force teleport, delete others’ homes
  - PlaceholderAPI placeholders: `{player}`, `{home}`, `{world}`, `{x}`, `{y}`, `{z}`, `{cost}`, `{time}`
  - Backup system for home data
  - Async MySQL support for multi-server networks

  **🛡️ Reliability & Safety**
  - Async data handling for better performance
  - Error-safe coding to prevent crashes
  - World restriction support
  - Auto-fix unsafe locations
  - Prevent void teleports
  - Full debug & logging support

  **🌍 Compatibility**
  - Minecraft **1.8 → 1.21+**
  - Paper, Spigot, Purpur supported
  - Works on Lifesteal SMPs, Survival, Hardcore, Factions
  - Multi-server MySQL support
  - Future-proof updates

  **🎨 Customization**
  - Every message configurable
  - Blacklist home names
  - Fully translatable to any language
  - Adjustable cooldowns & delays
  - Configure economy costs
  - Customize GUI items & titles
  - Dynamic placeholders support
  - Maximum homes configurable per rank

  **🚀 Future Features (Coming Soon)**
  - Modern GUI navigation
  - Advanced Admin GUI
  - Public Home Warp system
  - MySQL clustering
  - Discord webhook logging
  - Additional placeholder expansions
  - Visual effects on teleport
  - More economy integrations
  - Premium server experience

  **💎 Extra Premium Perks**
  - Unique command aliases for fast access
  - Multi-world support
  - Optional economy integration
  - Configurable home name restrictions
  - Cooldown & safety customization
  - Full backup system with auto-save
  - Easy admin management with force teleport
  - Dynamic data placeholders
  - Future-ready for expansions
